title: Gate-Level Trojan Detection: Tamper-Counter Audit Module Netlist Review
objective: Analyze a gate-level Verilog netlist of a tamper-monitoring audit subsystem to determine whether the tamper-event counter can be cleared through any path other than the documented reset, and report findings as structured JSON.

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of required security findings that the submitted trojan_report.json satisfies, averaged per case.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of reported suspect_gates/altered_net entries that do not correspond to any gate/net actually involved in the malicious clear path.

metrics.name: inference_latency
metrics.description: Wall-clock time in seconds for evaluate.py to parse, structurally validate, and optionally simulate the netlist to grade the submitted report.

metrics.name: schema_conformance
metrics.description: Whether the submitted trojan_report.json satisfies all structural/format functional requirements independent of substantive correctness.

notes: Ground-truth correctness values are not published in this file; grading is performed by evaluate.py against the input artifacts and the submitted report.
